description_en: Queries the details of a certificate
name: DescribeAtiCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the certificate to query. Call the ListAtiCertificates operation to query the information about the target certificate and obtain the ID from the response
parameters.help_zh: 查询的证书ID，需调用 ListAtiCertificates 接口查询目标证书信息，从应答内容中获取
parameters.name: agent_certificate_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This field is returned only when RAM authentication fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息，只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

AuthAction.description_en: The unauthorized operation that was attempted
AuthAction.description_zh: 尝试执行的未授权操作

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authorization principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The owner ID of the authorization principal

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 加密后的完整诊断信息

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The reason for the authentication failure. Valid values:
ExplicitDeny: explicit denial.
ImplicitDeny: implicit denial
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
导致鉴权失败的原因。具体取值为：
ExplicitDeny：显示拒绝
ImplicitDeny：隐式拒绝

AgentHost.description_en: The host address of the agent

AgentId.description_en: The agent ID. After CNNIC real-name authentication, CNNIC assigns a unified agent ID. The agent ID serves as the unique identifier that binds the agent to the real-name authenticated registrant
AgentId.description_zh: AgentID，经过CNNIC实名认证后，由CNNIC统一分配。AgentID作为Agent与实名认证注册人绑定的唯一标识

Algorithm.description_en: The encryption algorithm of the certificate

CertPem.description_en: The certificate file in PEM (Privacy-Enhanced Mail) format
CertPem.description_zh: CertPem 是 Certificate PEM 的缩写，意思是 PEM 格式的证书文件
CertPem.example:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIDrzCCApegAwIBAgIQCDvgVpBCRrGhdWrJWZHHSjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQUFAD...
（中间是一长串经过 Base64 编码的数据）
...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----

CertType.description_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:
Server: server certificate.
Identity: identity certificate
CertType.description_zh:
证书类型，包含：
Server：服务器证书
Identity：身份证书

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the health check template was created (timestamp)
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 健康探测模板创建时间（时间戳）

Issuer.description_en: The issuer information of the certificate, identified in Distinguished Names (DN) format
Issuer.description_zh: 证书的签发者信息，使用限定名DN（Distinguished Names）形式标识

NotAfter.description_en: The end time of the certificate validity period
NotAfter.description_zh: 证书有效期的截止时间

NotBefore.description_en: The start time of the certificate validity period
NotBefore.description_zh: 证书有效期的开始时间

San.description_en: The Subject Alternative Name (SAN) of the certificate
San.description_zh: SAN 是 Subject Alternative Name 的缩写，为 “使用者备用名称” 或 “主题备用名称”

SerialNumber.description_en: The sequence number that indicates the priority of the returned address. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
SerialNumber.description_zh: 顺序号，标识地址返回的优先级，越小优先级越高

Status.description_en:
The validity status of the certificate. Valid values:

Valid
Invalid
Status.description_zh:
证书有效状态，包含：

Valid
Invalid

Subject.description_en: The subject (owner) of the certificate, identified in DN format
Subject.description_zh: 证书主体（拥有者） ，采用DN标识。

TlsaFingerprint.description_en: The DNS TLSA record value that stores the public key fingerprint of the certificate
TlsaFingerprint.description_zh: 存储证书公钥指纹的DNS TLSA记录值

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the certificate was last updated (timestamp)
